chants.vernacular_text: You have loved justice and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your companions. ℣. My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my works to the King.
Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who alone accomplishes great wonders from all eternity. ℣. Let the mountains receive peace for the people, and the hills justice.
You have loved justice and hated iniquity. ℣. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord. The Lord God is our light.
I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord. We bless you from the house of the Lord; the Lord God is our light, alleluia, alleluia.
As for all of you who have been baptised in Christ, you have put on Christ, alleluia.
